parsing.notes: BLOCKED. Official Kosovo register. Endpoints: Services/KerkoBiznesin (search, Turnstile token), Services/TeDhenatBiznesit (details), Services/EksportoBizneset (export). All require the SPA bearer (401 otherwise) and the search a Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA token. Do NOT bypass. Field model documented from the SPA JS. NUI = Numri Fiskal (9-digit) = primary id; Numri TVSH = VAT (separate). Redact owners (Pronarët). Only open financial-ish field is registered Kapitali (EUR).

live_test_plan.smoke: Not runnable headless — bearer + Turnstile CAPTCHA required. Confirm access path with ARBK before any implementation.
live_test_plan.full: Blocked on authentication/CAPTCHA. Requires an official data-sharing agreement or API credentials from ARBK/MINT.

blockers: All Services/* endpoints return HTTP 401 without the SPA bearer token
Search (KerkoBiznesin) requires a Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA token
Export (EksportoBizneset) is auth-gated; no open bulk
No published open API key or data-sharing endpoint
